title: sonicetl ETL pipeline schema
description: The official ETL YAML schema consumed by the sonicetl native core. A pipeline declares one or more output datasets derived from a JSON input document; each record is parsed natively (sonic-rs) and the declared field expressions streamed into typed Parquet columns.

file_path.description: Path to the input JSON document (an array of records, or a single object).

json_path.description: Optional root path within the JSON to the record array (informational).

type.description: raw/master: one output row per input record. unwound: zero-or-more rows per record, driven by unwind_rules.

expression.description: Field expression. See docs/schema.md for the grammar.

unwind_path.description: JSON path to an array, e.g. "$.KIKOSelect.underlying"

output_alias.description: Alias under which each element is exposed to expressions, e.g. "symbol" -> "$.symbol".
